verdict.rationale: The Agents framework has a public GitHub repo (livekit/agents). The docs and llms.txt describe LiveKit as open-source, the plugins are called open source, and a hands-on probe confirmed the open-source framework installs from PyPI and npm. The only explicit license named, Apache-2.0, is for livekit-server, not the agents repo itself. Missing for 10: an explicit license identifier for the livekit/agents repo, and independent confirmation of the framework's license terms.
